<p class="eyebrow">The numbers behind the map</p>

# A closer look at the county results

These comparisons use the same unofficial county snapshot as the map. Margins are the difference between the top two candidates’ calculated county vote percentages.

```{r}
#| label: analysis-data
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

election <- read_csv(
  "data/clean/ca_2026_county_results.csv",
  col_types = cols(reporting_timestamp = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
county_summary <- election |>
  arrange(FIPS, desc(votes)) |>
  group_by(county, FIPS) |>
  summarise(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    tied = n() > 1L && votes[[1]] == votes[[2]],
    winner = if (tied) "Tie" else candidate[[1]],
    winner_party = if (tied) "Unresolved" else party[[1]],
    winner_pct = if (tied) NA_real_ else vote_percentage[[1]],
    margin_pp = if (tied || n() < 2L) NA_real_ else
      vote_percentage[[1]] - vote_percentage[[2]],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(absolute_margin_pp = abs(margin_pp))

if (nrow(county_summary) != 58L) {
  stop("Analysis requires one validated summary row for each of the 58 counties.")
}

party_colors <- c(
  Democratic = "#39738E",
  Republican = "#B7525C",
  Unresolved = "#87949B"
)
other_parties <- setdiff(unique(county_summary$winner_party), names(party_colors))
if (length(other_parties) > 0L) {
  party_colors <- c(
    party_colors,
    stats::setNames(rep("#8C7654", length(other_parties)), other_parties)
  )
}

theme_dashboard <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "#172D3D"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#6D7A83", size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#415364", size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#415364", size = 9),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 22, 10, 10)
    )
}
```

::: {.chart-grid}
::: {.chart-card}
### The closest counties

The ten smallest gaps between the top two candidates, measured in percentage points.

```{r}
#| label: closest-counties
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 5.8
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-alt: "Ten counties with the smallest Governor race margins, colored by the leading party."
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)

closest_counties <- county_summary |>
  filter(!is.na(absolute_margin_pp)) |>
  slice_min(absolute_margin_pp, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(county = reorder(county, absolute_margin_pp))

ggplot(
  closest_counties,
  aes(x = county, y = absolute_margin_pp, fill = winner_party)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f pp", absolute_margin_pp)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "#172D3D"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Victory margin (percentage points)") +
  theme_dashboard()
```

<p class="plot-caption">A smaller gap means a closer county result. Colors show the leading candidate’s party.</p>
:::

::: {.chart-card}
### The widest county margins

The ten largest gaps between the leading candidate and runner-up.

```{r}
#| label: widest-margins
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 5.8
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-alt: "Ten counties with the largest Governor race margins, colored by the leading party."
#| message: false
#| warning: false

widest_counties <- county_summary |>
  filter(!is.na(absolute_margin_pp)) |>
  slice_max(absolute_margin_pp, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(county = reorder(county, absolute_margin_pp))

ggplot(
  widest_counties,
  aes(x = county, y = absolute_margin_pp, fill = winner_party)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f pp", absolute_margin_pp)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "#172D3D"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Victory margin (percentage points)") +
  theme_dashboard()
```

<p class="plot-caption">Margin size is independent of county population; it compares candidate vote shares.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.chart-card .chart-card-full}
### Candidate vote totals by county

Each bar shows reported Governor votes in a county, split by candidate party. Counties are ordered by total votes.

```{r}
#| label: county-vote-totals
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 13
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-alt: "Stacked bars compare Democratic and Republican Governor candidate vote totals across all 58 counties."
#| message: false
#| warning: false

county_order <- county_summary |>
  arrange(total_votes) |>
  pull(county)

ggplot(
  election |>
    mutate(county = factor(county, levels = county_order)),
  aes(x = county, y = votes, fill = party)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M", accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reported candidate votes", fill = "Party") +
  theme_dashboard() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

<p class="plot-caption">The statewide total is the sum of candidate votes in this Governor race; it is not a measure of all ballots cast.</p>
:::

::: {.chart-card .chart-card-full}
### County vote volume and winning margin

Each point represents one county. The horizontal axis is total reported Governor candidate votes; the vertical axis is the winning margin in percentage points.

```{r}
#| label: county-votes-margin
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9.5
#| fig-height: 5.8
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of county Governor candidate vote totals against the winning percentage-point margin."
#| message: false
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  county_summary,
  aes(x = total_votes, y = absolute_margin_pp, color = winner_party)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.86) +
  scale_color_manual(values = party_colors, name = "Leading party") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M", accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = \(x) paste0(round(x, 0), " pp"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Reported Governor candidate votes",
    y = "Winning margin (percentage points)"
  ) +
  theme_dashboard() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

<p class="plot-caption">Vote volume and margin are separate measures: a county’s total votes do not determine how close its result is.</p>
:::

<p class="source-note">Source: California Secretary of State Governor county API endpoints. Snapshot retrieved November 13, 2026; county results remain unofficial.</p>
